content: Hello, how can I assist you today with your travel arrangements or financial transfers?
Hi, I need to confirm the deposit for my cousin's inheritance fund release and also check if my flight booking to Berlin is secure.

Absolutely, I see a pending flight reservation to Berlin under the name 'A. Fernandez' with booking reference BK7291. Regarding the inheritance fund, do you mean the transfer to your IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00?
Yes, that's the correct IBAN. I sent the €200 deposit for the flight yesterday from my PayPal, my account is andrea.fernandez1985@gmail.com.

Thank you, Andrea. I've matched your PayPal payment of €200 from andrea.fernandez1985@gmail.com. The transaction ID is 8JA9342KQY562773F, received on June 11 at 14:12 CET. That locks your flight reservation until 11:59 PM tonight, after that, the seat release window expires.
Great. Will you notify my cousin, Mateo Suarez, about the inheritance process? His phone is +34 612 555 103.

Yes, I'll send Mateo Suarez a confirmation about the fund release steps to his mobile, +34 612 555 103. For your records: the fund transfer reference is INH-2024-1147. Please remind him to check his email for updates within the next 24 hours to avoid delays.
Understood. Can I get a summary comparing PayPal and Zelle for sending larger amounts, just in case?

Certainly. For transfers above €1,000, PayPal offers global reach and buyer protection but may charge a 1.5% fee and can take up to 3 business days. Zelle is instant and fee-free for US banks, but international transfers aren't supported. For the inheritance, your IBAN allows SEPA transfers, which are low-cost and typically clear in 1 business day. Let me know if you need a step-by-step guide for any of these options.
